sign_in.label: Sign in with an ARD account
sign_in.description: Link your ARD account to sync your subscriptions and listening progress. You confirm the login in your browser on accounts.ard.de.

max_num_episodes.label: Maximum bitrate for streams (0 for unlimited)
max_num_episodes.description: Maximum bitrate for streams. Use 0 for unlimited

podcast_finished_time.label: Percentage required before podcast episode is marked as fully played
podcast_finished_time.description: This setting defines how much of a podcast must be listened to before an episode is marked as fully played

user.title: Set up ARD Sounds
user.description: ARD Sounds works without an account. Sign in to sync your subscriptions and listening progress with your ARD account.

device_login.title: Sign in to your ARD account
device_login.description: Your code is {0}. Use the button below to open the ARD login with the code already filled in, or go to accounts.ard.de/id on another device and enter it there. This screen updates automatically once you have signed in.

errors.login_failed: Signing in to your ARD account failed. Please try again.

manifest.description: Stream radio shows, news, and podcasts from ARD Sounds (Germany’s public broadcaster).
